command: timeout 5 sh -c 'fsize=$(stat -c%s -- /home/readme.txt) || exit 1; off=0; if [ "$off" -lt 0 ]; then start=$(( fsize + off )); else start=$off; fi; if [ "$start" -lt 0 ]; then start=0; fi; if [ "$start" -gt "$fsize" ]; then start=$fsize; fi; bs=5; skip=$(( start / bs )); printf '"'"'%s\n%s\n'"'"' "$fsize" "$start"; dd if=/home/readme.txt bs="$bs" skip="$skip" count=2'
